title: Iterable Campaign
description: A marketing campaign in Iterable that delivers messages to targeted audiences across email, push, SMS, and in-app channels. Campaigns can be blast sends to lists, triggered by events or API calls, or proof/test sends.

templateId.description: ID of the message template used by this campaign

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the campaign was created

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the campaign was last modified

startAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the scheduled start time

endedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the campaign finished sending

messageMedium.description: The messaging channel used by this campaign

campaignState.description: Current state of the campaign lifecycle

listIds.description: IDs of lists targeted by this campaign

suppressionListIds.description: IDs of suppression lists to exclude from targeting

labels.description: Labels applied to the campaign for organization

workflowId.description: ID of the workflow this campaign belongs to, if applicable

dataFields.description: Custom data fields for campaign-level personalization
